facts.business: Amber Enterprises India Limited is a diversified B2B manufacturing solutions provider with capabilities spanning Consumer Durables, Electronics, and Railway Subsystems & Defence.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualification relates to the inclusion of unaudited financial statements of one subsidiary and one joint venture, which were approved by the Management and furnished to the auditors.
